'''RC-D03 Battle Droid''' was a model of three-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[war against Zakuul]]. Many droids of this model were used by the [[Rike's Raiders]] unit led by Republic General [[Amos Rike]] during the [[Assault on Denova]] in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
RC-D03 Battle Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Trench Runner" Uprising.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
